#   fixed     the defect is gone; the note names the commit
#   filed     tracked in the backlog; the note names the section
#   external  raised by a dependency, not our code path; the note says why
# Copy the suggested line from the script's output rather than typing it: the
# payload column must match its normalization exactly.
